defs.def: an illness affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection 病；疾病

ex.s: Pick out diseased plants in the forestB.
ex.t: 从森林中挑选出患病植物。

ex.s: Treating various diseases.
ex.t: 每种文学类型都有独特的结局。

ex.s: Examples of rare animal diseases.
ex.t: 罕见动物疾病的例子。

ex.s: They may carry diseases.
ex.t: 它们可能携带疾病。

ex.s: David had a brain disease which prevented him from walking or running like other children, but at school his classmates thought of him as a regular kid.
ex.t: David患有一种脑部疾病，使他无法像其他孩子一样走路或跑步，但在学校里同学们把他当作普通孩子看待。

ex.s: David had a brain disease which prevented him from walking or running like other children, but at school his classmates thought of him as a regular kid.
ex.t: David患有一种脑部疾病，使他无法像其他孩子一样走路或跑步，但在学校里同学们把他当作普通孩子看待。

ex.s: It is believed that today's children and teenagers are consuming three times the recommended level of sugar, putting them at a higher risk of the disease.
ex.t: 最初糖税预计每年为国库带来5.2亿英镑收入。

ex.s: Experimental studies on diseases.
ex.t: 关于疾病的实验性研究。

ex.s: One day I got word that he was admitted to hospital for a serious disease.
ex.t: 有一天我听说他因重病住院了。

ex.s: Tracking of 150 biochemicals in food has been important in revealing the relationships between calories, sugar, fat and the occurrence of common diseases.
ex.t: 对食物中150种生化物质的追踪在揭示卡路里、糖、脂肪与常见疾病发生之间的关系方面发挥了重要作用。

ex.s: Often due to various pressures, we tend to ignore our health. ____35____ It is the fitness level of our body that helps us fight these diseases.
ex.t: 往往由于各种压力，我们倾向于忽视我们的健康。____35____正是我们身体的健康水平帮助我们抵抗这些疾病。

ex.s: This makes our body suffer and we will catch other diseases.
ex.t: 这会让我们的身体受苦，我们会染上其他疾病。

ex.s: A new study has ____ the causes of the disease, and it’s likely that a cure will soon be found.
ex.t: 一项新研究已经____了这种疾病的原因，很可能很快就能找到治疗方法。

ex.s: Cure the diseased cattle.
ex.t: 把牛转移到另一个牧场。

ex.s: It got a skin disease.
ex.t: 它得了皮肤病。

ex.s: And in Karakalpakstan, he is saddened by the dust storms, diseases and fishing boats stuck miles from the sea.
ex.t: 在卡拉卡尔帕克斯坦他为沙尘暴、疾病和搁浅在远离海边数英里的渔船而悲伤。

ex.s: Developing a serious mental disease.
ex.t: 患上了严重的精神疾病。

ex.s: If we drink dirty water, we can catch diseases from the bacteria and become ill.
ex.t: 那大约是每天1400名儿童！

ex.s: Two of the authors of the review also made a study published in 2014  66  showed a mere five to 10 minutes A day of running reduced the risk of heart disease and early deaths from all  67    (cause).
ex.t: 该综述的两位作者还在2014年发表了一项研究____66____表明每天仅5到10分钟的跑步就能降低心脏病和各种____67____（原因）导致的早死风险。

ex.s: Teenagers’ sleep-related diseases.
ex.t: 美国孩子的睡眠习惯。

ex.s: But the disease is making a comeback, caused by a growing anti-vaccine movement and misinformation that is spreading quickly.
ex.t: 那些拒绝承担这种风险的自私行为让其他人受苦。

ex.s: B: We should tell them it’s dirty and it can spread diseases.
ex.t: B：我们应该告诉他们水很脏，会传播疾病。

ex.s: There are no borders for doctors, for patients or for anyone else involved in combating this terrible disease.
ex.t: 医生、病人或任何参与抗击这种可怕疾病的人都没有国界。

ex.s: My mission was to relieve Emma, a Canadian specialist in infectious diseases at the end of her posting.
ex.t: 我的任务是与Emma交接，她是一位加拿大传染病专家，即将结束她的任务期。

ex.s: Shortly after recovery, she decided to help find out the cause of this disease.
ex.t: 康复后不久，她决定帮助找出这种疾病的原因。

ex.s: Doctors battle new disease Doctors are flying to an island off the coast of West Africa after an outbreak of a new disease caused by a flu virus.
ex.t: 医生与新疾病作斗争 在一种由流感病毒引起的新型疾病爆发后，医生们正飞往西非海岸附近的一个岛屿。

defs.def: something that is very wrong with people's attitudes, way of life or with society 弊端；恶疾；痼疾

ex.s: Scientists think this is the plants' way to prevent the spread of any tree diseases and make life more difficult for leaf-eating insects like caterpillars.
ex.t: 要在森林中生存，动物必须攀爬、跳跃或飞越这些空隙。
